features.name: VCF triage baseline
features.description: Annotate the provided joint VCF and produce the first candidate table - the reproducible baseline every later ranking is compared against. Known specifics: keep PASS only (4,740,790 of 5,012,204), drop the 116,485 records on alt/random/decoy contigs, and carry the no-chr <-> chr conversion explicitly since submissions are matched by exact tuple equality. Primary genetic model is COMPOUND HETEROZYGOUS (two rare damaging alleles in one gene) - both the scoring code's answer key and the absence of any ROH point there; de novo dominant is the second model. Rank against the full feat-002 multi-system constellation. Treat seven terms as proband observations and `HP:0200067` as a separate but clinically meaningful family-history feature within the phenotype input—not as a proband abnormality and not as disposable background. It can inform inherited and newly arising mechanism hypotheses but does not distinguish them.

features.name: GC-corrected copy-number and BAF screen
features.description: The provided VCF contains no CNV or structural records at all (genotypes are only 0/1, 1/1, 1/2), so MVA's defining mosaic aneuploidy is invisible in it. A quick 10 Mb BAF/depth screen (notes/data-profile.md) excluded high-level aneuploidy but left chr20 (and 19, 22) unresolved and confounded with GC/mappability bias. Redo it properly with GC-corrected read-depth binning and a mappability mask so the chr20 signal is either confirmed as low-level mosaic trisomy or attributed to bias. Small and targeted - this does not require re-calling the genome.
features.evidence: scripts/run_copy_number_screen.sh implements an all-lane, no-retained-BAM screen with 100 kb GC/mappability bins, MAPQ>=30 depth, high-quality heterozygous-SNV BAF, deterministic block bootstraps and a >=0.95 mappability sensitivity run. The real run accepted 868,096,455 primary nonduplicate alignments. At both thresholds chr20 is no gain after correction, chr22 lacks joint BAF support, and chr19 has joint support consistent with a low-level mosaic gain; notes/copy-number-screen.md records commands, aggregate intervals and limitations. `./scripts/run_copy_number_screen.sh --self-check` and the full local command pass. The result does not establish candidate-variant phase; trans phase remains unconfirmed.

features.name: Targeted realignment for missed alleles
features.description: OPTIONAL, contingent on feat-004's candidate list. features.name: Local scorer and submission conformance
features.description: Only 6 Track 1 submissions exist; none should be spent discovering a formatting bug. Vendor the challenge's public evaluation.py and track1_submission_template.csv into scripts/ and self-score every candidate CSV locally first. Must enforce: proband_id is exactly PROBAND01; chrom fields are chr-prefixed (the scorer only .strip()s them, so unprefixed names silently score zero); at most 10 rows; strictly distinct epcr values in (0,1] since ties collapse F-max thresholds; indels left-aligned and represented as the answer key would have them. Strategy note: rows with epcr BELOW the true row are free - they cannot lower F-max and do not move rank points - so fill all 10.
features.evidence: scripts/vendor/evaluation.py pins the organizers' byte-identical public scorer at revision 1c761cc23d90aebe6a011fd5b0b99517df42408c; scripts/track1_submission_template.csv vendors its schema; scripts/track1_submission.py builds, validates and hypothetically self-scores the ten-row compound-pair draft. `uv run python scripts/track1_submission.py --self-check`, `uv run python scripts/track1_submission.py build`, and `uv run python scripts/track1_submission.py check` pass. The real local draft has 10 distinct descending EPCRs and 20 reference-confirmed, minimal, left-aligned alleles; under the explicitly hypothetical assumption that row 1 is truth, the official scorer returns rank points 100 and F-max 1.0. This does not use the private answer key or confirm biology; the leading BUB1B pair remains unphased and trans phase remains unconfirmed. See notes/submission-conformance.md.
